content: Two existing cross-lingual pre-training methods, Masked Language Modeling (MLM) and Translation Language Modeling (TLM), have shown their effectiveness on XNLI cross-lingual classification task BIBREF11, BIBREF28, but these methods have not been well studied on cross-lingual generation tasks in zero-shot condition. We attempt to take advantage of the cross-lingual ability of the two methods for zero-shot translation.
